_deploy_notes: ONE Railway service runs the ENTIRE Null City stack from this image.
Attach ONE Volume mounted at /data (the container sets DATA_ROOT=/data and routes every runtime write under it).

Public ingress is the dashboard BFF; Railway injects $PORT and the entrypoint binds it on 0.0.0.0. All other ports (game 43594, gateway 43595, login 43591, update 43592, letters 43596, mcp 43610, city 43611) are in-container only.
REQUIRED env: INFERENCE_BASE_URL, INFERENCE_API_KEY, INFERENCE_MODEL (remote inference).
RECOMMENDED env: CONTROLLER_INSTANCE_ID, CONTROLLER_CITY_HTTP_TOKEN, AGENT_GATEWAY_AUTH_TOKEN, NULLCITY_CITY_API_TOKEN, CONTROLLER_ENABLE_AP_GP_EXCHANGE=false.
Build-args for the dashboard clone: DASHBOARD_REPO (with token if private), DASHBOARD_REF (default wip/spec).
Plan: the full stack in one container needs ~8-16GB RAM (game heap 4GB + controller + BFF + bun). See docs/2026-06-11-railway-allinone.md.
